items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; conditional for ordinary reversible growth; blocked for security-sensitive exposure, new public launches, and release changes requiring unverified controls. Evidence: security baseline covers 61 sites but fleet-doctor is not operational (ok=false, last_run=null), operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps have no results, and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness are not evidenced. Compliance records 37 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown, but this is technical baseline evidence only. TLS has no certificates expiring within 30 days, which is a limited positive signal—not proof of TLS configuration correctness. Exact decision: preserve existing security-sensitive and private-launch gates; permit only no-credential, no-permission, no-dependency, no-configuration, no-tracking, no-cross-site reversible work; continue bounded read-only evidence capture; do not claim certification or a clean bill of health.

SearchWoot remains security-blocked and private. Evidence: the launch checklist reports the security and release gate blocked; access, secret, isolation, TLS, dependency, monitoring, incident, data-exposure, and disclosure evidence is incomplete. Legal also reports 0 of 4 readiness tasks evidenced closed and upstream data-use rights blocked. Exact decision: retain the private gate and permit only read-only internal evidence work; no public beta, credential/configuration changes, notification expansion, deployment, or external outreach.
